title: UNM #SaveMisha multi-site rallies for Saakashvili
location: Tbilisi (Government Administration and Rike/Peace Bridge); Batumi; Kutaisi; Zugdidi; Chorvila and Shekvetili area; additional sites reported or announced but unresolved.
scope: Coordinated multi-site campaign-day reported on January 4. The articles differ on locations and times; this is one provisional country-level episode key, not a claim that all assemblies were simultaneous or that every planned site was occupied.
organizer: United National Movement (UNM) for the reported city rallies. The precise organizational relationship of the 14:00 Chorvila/Shekvetili action to the city rallies requires review.
participants_original: No site-specific attendance estimate is reported in the opened articles.
threshold_50_evidence: The opened reporting confirms physical gatherings in multiple locations but provides no attendee count for any single Georgian site. Countrywide planning, the number of cities, and international rallies cannot establish 50 simultaneous participants at an individual site; keep pending threshold.

start_date.summary: Each opened report dates its relevant gathering or rally activity to 2023-01-04; no more precise event start time is established for the full series.

end_date.summary: No opened report establishes the physical end time or last day of this campaign-day activity; end date remains unknown.

location.summary: Opened reports place activity in Tbilisi, Batumi, Kutaisi, Zugdidi and the Chorvila/Shekvetili area. They report different site lists; extra announced sites are not treated as completed gatherings.

scope.summary: The opened articles describe rallies in multiple Georgian locations on the same date. Site-by-site linkage, simultaneity and total count of completed sites are not resolved.

organizer.summary: UNM is identified as organizer or participant for the city rallies; reports describe Saakashvili supporters in the Chorvila action, whose exact relation to the party-organized series remains uncertain.

demands.summary: Reports describe requests to release or transfer Saakashvili abroad for treatment because of his health; the Kutaisi report specifically says participants asked President Salome Zourabichvili to pardon him.

state_target.summary: The Kutaisi account directly identifies the President as the addressee of a pardon request; broader reports describe a release/medical-transfer demand in relation to the Georgian authorities.

participants_original.summary: No opened account supplies a crowd count for any individual Georgian site. International participation descriptions are not used for domestic site counts.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No site-level count is given; the 50-person minimum remains unverified at every named Georgian gathering.

protester_violence.summary: RFE/RL reports a clash in Chorvila between Ivanishvili supporters and Saakashvili demonstrators but does not attribute acts of violence to the coded participants; violence remains unknown.

state_response.summary: The opened reports do not establish a response by state agents or officials to these gatherings; each response field remains unknown.

notes: A reported campaign day with physical gathering evidence and an explicit state-directed political-process demand; not an official inclusion. Civil Georgia describes two Tbilisi sites and a Chorvila event at 14:00; city demonstrations are reported for 18:00. 1TV reports eight planned venues but does not give comparable completion/count evidence for all of them. Batumelebi names only some planned locations and separately mentions Shekvetili. Do not sum participants across cities or include international rallies in any threshold.
open_questions: Did each completed Georgian site independently have 50 or more simultaneous participants?
Which of the announced eight sites actually held a physical gathering, and what was the exact site list?
Were the two Tbilisi locations separate assemblies, faction events, or one linked gathering?
Was the Chorvila/Shekvetili action part of the 18:00 UNM campaign or a distinct 14:00 episode?
Did the doctors’ rally near the presidential administration overlap or form a separate gathering?
What were the exact physical start and end times at each location?
What specific response, if any, came from state officials or agents?
Do later or earlier rallies represent separate episodes or continuity?
